name: ByteAsk
long_description: ByteAsk is an AI coding agent built for low level languages like C, C++ and CUDA, the code that runs trading systems, cars, chips, and inference. It does not stop at a diff that looks right. ByteAsk builds, debugs, and tests every change with the real toolchain until the change holds. If the compiler, the debugger, or the tests can catch it, then ByteAsk catches it too. It runs from the terminal or inside VS Code, Neovim, and Emacs, and is available fully on-prem. As agents run most software, the bottleneck becomes how fast and compute-efficient that software is. Our bet is that in that world software is written in assembly, and ByteAsk agents will write it.
one_liner: The AI coding agent for C, C++ and CUDA
